remarks: Welcome to Prescott, a family-friendly community with parks, amenities, and everyday conveniences. This beautifully designed home features an open-concept main floor with 9' ceilings, a spacious kitchen with a large island, walk-in pantry, quartz countertops, and a functional mudroom. The great room is highlighted by a modern 50 linear electric fireplace.  The separate side entrance and 9' basement foundation height offer excellent future development potential, complete with a bathroom rough-in.  Upstairs, the spacious primary bedroom includes a walk-in closet and a 4-piece ensuite with dual sinks and a stand-up shower. Two additional bedrooms, a central bonus room, a full bathroom, and convenient upper-floor laundry complete the second level.  Premium finishes include quartz countertops throughout, luxury vinyl plank flooring on the main floor, bathrooms, and laundry room, plus upgraded stain-resistant carpet on the second floor. A perfect blend of style, comfort, and fun. Photos representative (id:67522)
